name: Vetoquinol SA
summary: Vetoquinol SA, a veterinary pharmaceutical company, designs, develops, and sells veterinary drugs and non-medicinal products in Europe, the Americas, and the Asia Pacific region. It provides products in the areas of pain management, anti-infective, cardiology-nephrology, care and hygiene, antiparasiticides, behavior, internal medicine, and reproduction for cats, dogs, cattle, and pigs. The company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Lure, France. Vetoquinol SA is a subsidiary of Soparfin SCA.
